meta.note: Recorded Soroban inclusion-fee p50 series, in stroops. The scheduler only ever compares the policy-selected percentile, so the fixture records that one series per scenario; the loader reconstructs a nominal distribution around each level (see fee-series.ts). Cadence is 30s rather than the observer's per-ledger ~6s to keep the recording readable — the decision logic is cadence-independent.

series.name: lull
series.note: A busy opening that calms down: the fee drops under a 150-stroop budget a few minutes in, so the scheduler submits at the threshold.

series.name: spike
series.note: Sustained congestion: the fee never reaches the budget. The held signature lapses at 30 min (forcing a re-sign), and the deadline fallback submits at the 45-minute mark.
